test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Abort
solution: The correct answer is: **Commence**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Abort **means to stop or cancel something before it is completed. (किसी चीज़ को पूरा होने से पहले रोकना या रद्द करना) • **For example**: *The mission had to be aborted due to technical issues.* • Marked option** Commence **means to begin or start something. (किसी चीज़ को शुरू करना) • **For example**: *They will commence the construction of the new building next month.* • The two words are opposite in meaning. Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Commode **refers to a type of toilet. (एक प्रकार का शौचालय) • **Command **means to give orders or be in charge of something. (आदेश देना या किसी चीज़ का प्रभारी होना) • **Collision **means a crash or impact between two objects. (दो वस्तुओं के बीच दुर्घटना या प्रभाव) 36:Tc8e, The correct answer is: **Thrown**.
